title: 第二十一章青峰武馆试功弟子第二十二章顾晦的选择
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
大齐帝国，以武立国。
前世古代，通过科举考上功名才有资格做官，这一世也是如此，只不过，并不是考儒家经典罢了，而是进行武道考核，考的是武道功名，有功名者才能做官。
若是不通文墨，怎么处理政事？
当官的自然有幕僚随从，可以招聘书院出身的文士为吏员，协助自己处理事务。
何况，西瓜大的字认不得一筐的粗鲁汉子在武道一途上也走不了多远。
每一年的三月，帝国各地都会进行武道考核。
并非所有人都可以报名参加武道考核，参加武道考核是有门槛的，必须有人举荐。
什么人才有资格举荐？
如果一个家族，有两个人在朝廷当官，其家族也就有两封举荐信，可以举荐两个人参加武道考核，人数越多，举荐信也就越多，官员越多的家族势力也就越强大。
像顾晦这样的普通人怎么办？
家族里面没人当官，无人举荐，修炼出一身好本事想要卖身给朝廷怎么办？
他们可以走武馆推荐这条路。
大齐帝国的正规武馆，都有着衙门颁布的传武令，得到了传武令才有资格开馆收徒授艺。
这样的武馆，才有资格推荐弟子参加每一年的武道考核，搏一个前程出来。
当然，有资格获得武馆举荐信的弟子都是万中无一的天才，是武馆众多弟子里面的佼佼者，大部分修炼的弟子因为根骨或者资源的问题，走不到那一步。
即便如此，他们也不是没有前途。
只要能够锤炼出气血，练出了劲，成为武者，就算不能参加官府的武道考核，没资格做官，也不是赚不到钱，可以去大户人家当护院，去镖行跑镖，参加帮派……
顾晦前世，底层想要改变命运唯有读书。
这一世，底层想要改变命运唯有练武，然而，这条路也是有门槛的，需要大量钱财。
白沙镇有三个武馆，长河、白云，以及顾晦面前的青峰武馆。

就算收费最低的青峰武馆，入门费就要十五两白银，也就是相当于前世的一万五千元，并不是说交了这十五两白银就高枕无忧，可以一直在武馆修炼，没有其他的消费。
前世有资料费，书本费，补课费……
练武的额外花销更多，辅佐修炼的丹药非常昂贵，与之相比，入门费只是小儿科。
顾晦的爷爷顾天北有着一个桐油作坊。
顾长富在作坊做事，顾长贵是一个商社的管事，家里没人闲着，靠着全家人的托举，顾谭方才能在面前这青峰武馆修行，为此，顾长青都给了三十来两银子。
若非如此，他们家本可以过得不这么紧巴。
像现在，一旦出现了变故，存银瞬间见底。
其实，真正的底层是没可能进入武馆改变命运的，最多像顾晦的父亲顾长青那样花钱去市面上购买不入品的炼体功法，自己摸索，看能不能有所收获。
顾长青这样算是运气比较好的。
更多的人练不出名堂，没能淬炼出气血，更有甚者，走火入魔，一命呜呼。
大门紧闭，门后传来了吐气呼喝声。
顾晦没有上前敲门，他这样的身份不可能让人正门大开迎接，他看了看牌匾，绕过大门，转入一侧的小巷，沿着武馆围墙一直快要走到小巷尽头。
content_en:
The Da Qi Empire was founded by force.
In ancient times, only those who passed the imperial examination were qualified to be officials. This is also the case in this life. However, it is not a test of Confucian classics, but a martial arts assessment. The test is for martial arts merit. Only those with merit can be officials.
If you don't know how to write and write, how can you deal with political affairs?
Officials naturally have staff and attendants, and they can recruit scribes from academies as officials to assist them in handling affairs.
What's more, a rude man who can't read a basket with words as big as watermelons won't get very far in the martial arts.
Every year in March, martial arts assessments are held across the empire.
Not everyone can sign up to take the martial arts assessment. There are thresholds for participating in the martial arts assessment, and someone must recommend it.
Who is qualified to recommend?
If a family has two people serving as officials in the court, the family will also have two letters of recommendation, and they can recommend two people to participate in the martial arts assessment. The more people there are, the more letters of recommendation will be. The more officials the family has, the more powerful it will be.
What should ordinary people like Gu Hui do?
No one in the family is an official, no one recommends him, what should he do if he develops a good skill and wants to sell himself to the court?
They can take this path recommended by martial arts schools.
The regular martial arts schools in the Da Qi Empire all have martial arts orders issued by the Yamen. Only those who have obtained the martial arts orders are eligible to open the gym to accept apprentices and teach skills.
Only such martial arts schools are qualified to recommend students to participate in the annual martial arts assessment and strive for a bright future.
Of course, the disciples who are qualified to receive letters of recommendation from martial arts schools are unique geniuses and are the best among the many disciples in the martial arts academy. Most of the disciples who practice cannot make it to that step due to problems with their abilities or resources.
Even so, they are not without a future.
As long as you can temper your energy and strength, and become a martial artist, even if you cannot participate in the government's martial arts assessment and are not qualified to be an official, it is not impossible to make money. You can work as a nurse for a wealthy family, work as an escort in a escort agency, join a gang...
In Gu Hui's previous life, the only way for the lower class to change their destiny was to study.
In this life, the only way for the bottom to change their destiny is to practice martial arts. However, this path also has barriers and requires a lot of money.
There are three martial arts gyms in Baisha Town, Changhe, Baiyun, and Qingfeng martial arts gym in front of Gu Hui.
Even for Qingfeng Martial Arts School, which charges the lowest fees, the entrance fee is fifteen taels of silver, which is equivalent to fifteen thousand yuan in the previous life. It does not mean that after paying these fifteen taels of silver, you can sit back and relax and can keep practicing in the martial arts gym without any other expenses.
In the previous life, there were materials fees, book fees, tuition fees...
The additional costs of practicing martial arts are higher, and the elixirs to assist in training are very expensive. Compared with this, the entry fee is just child's play.
Gu Hui's grandfather Gu Tianbei owns a tung oil workshop.
Gu Changfu works in a workshop, and Gu Changgui is a manager of a trading company. No one in the family is idle. With the help of the whole family, Gu Tanfang can practice in the Qingfeng Martial Arts School in front of him. For this, Gu Changqing gave him thirty taels of silver.
If not for this, their family's life would not be so tight.
Like now, once something unexpected happens, the bank deposit will bottom out instantly.
In fact, it is impossible for the real bottom class to enter a martial arts gym to change their destiny. At most, like Gu Hui's father Gu Changqing, they can spend money to buy inferior body-training techniques on the market and explore on their own to see if they can gain anything.
Gu Changqing is relatively lucky.
There are more people who fail to achieve fame and refine their qi and blood, and even worse, they become obsessed and die.
The door was closed tightly, and the sound of exhaling and shouting came from behind the door.
Gu Hui did not knock on the door. With his status, it was impossible for the front door to be opened wide to greet him. He looked at the plaque, walked around the door, turned into an alley on one side, and followed the wall of the martial arts hall until he was almost at the end of the alley.
